articles.summary: Veeva Systems (NYSE: VEEV) today announced that Veeva DQS (Data Quality System) has aggregated and cleaned data for more than 1 million subjects in more than 1,000 studies to accelerate the delivery of analysis-ready data and trial insights. With more than 500,000 automated queries, Veeva DQS has saved thousands of hours in data reconciliation for sites and sponsors. "One key area for us is handling the increasing volume of data generated from our growing number of clinical trials," said Ibrahim Kamstrup-Akkaoui, vice president at Novo. "Veeva DQS can help us manage, format, clean, and prepare this data for submission more efficiently." Veeva DQS enables next-generation clinical data management with advancements essential for adopting the risk-based strategies recommended in regulatory guidelines, including ICH E6(R3). articles.title: Veeva DQS Cleans Data for More Than 1 Million Subjects Across Over 1,000 Studies

articles.summary: Veeva Systems (NYSE: VEEV) today announced that more than 175 emerging biotechs are establishing a technology foundation with Veeva Basics . Biotechs are launching pre-configured and pre-validated Veeva Basics applications in weeks, adding systems that can scale as they move from startup to commercialization. Veeva Basics delivers unified, end-to-end applications for clinical, regulatory, quality, medical, and commercial, enabling high-growth companies to speed innovation while saving time, effort, and cost. "As a growing company with under 40 employees, we're focused on developing science fast to deliver antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) that target difficult-to-treat cancers," said Bryan Ball, chief technology operations officer at Whitehawk Therapeutics. "Our partnership with Veeva helped us replace paper processes with industry-leading solutions without an IT team or complex customizations. articles.summary: IQVIA (NYSE: IQV) and Veeva Systems (NYSE: VEEV) today announced an expansion of their partnership with the selection of Veeva CTMS, eTMF, Study Startup, and Site Connect as enterprise standard applications that will be used across IQVIA clinical development studies. This extends the previously announced EDC partnership. Together, IQVIA and Veeva bring best-in-class capabilities to clinical research to help customers increase trial speed and efficiency, strengthen site centricity, and make better-informed decisions, ultimately helping get life-changing treatments to patients faster. All Veeva clinical solutions are also available through IQVIA for sponsors who wish to enable a full Veeva technology stack.
